notes: 24 modules: fit + fight per stage. APPLIES THE ARCADE SESSION STANDARD (specs/27, data/arcade-session-standards.json). FIT modules now carry a counted `prescription` (sets x reps/sec + category + tier); stored numbers are the NORMAL baseline, the app re-resolves easy/hard from the volume ladder by tier+category. FIGHT modules carry `round_source`, a `canonical_map` (thematic drill -> canonical discipline + move), and a `finishers` block (explosive bodyweight between/after rounds, capped, counting toward the plyo cap). Tier map: T1 stages 1-3, T2 4-6, T3 7-9, T4 10-12. 'difficulty' is the normal baseline; 'difficulty_variants' override sets/rounds/rest per the campaign difficulty_scaling. Fight round counts/lengths resolve from campaign.difficulty_scaling.fight unless a module overrides (Stage 12 boss does). Taper stages 10-11 additionally apply campaign.stage_load_multiplier to volume and stay DELOAD-light (tier ladder not applied). SAFETY: power without control is failure — never reward reckless technique, intentionally absorbing strikes, or poor form used to complete a higher difficulty; jumping strikes are excluded on easy; neck work stays gentle and controlled. Split stages 4-11 are SKILL-FIRST (fight = morning, fit = evening).

both_rules.description: When a stage is run as BOTH (fit + fight combined).
both_rules.sequencing: Skill/fight first while fresh, then fit. Stages 4-11 are already skill-first split (fight = AM, fit = PM); stages 1-3 and 12 are single-session, so BOTH runs fight -> fit back-to-back.
both_rules.shared_plyo_cap: The campaign plyo foot-contact cap is counted ACROSS the whole session — fight finishers + fit explosive share it; if combined would exceed it, the fit explosive block trims first.
both_rules.volume_sanity: In a single-session BOTH (stages 1-3, 12), fit accessory volume may drop one notch so two full high-volume blocks aren't stacked.
both_rules.readiness: A BOTH day is a HARD day: readiness gate applies before starting, and it won't schedule back-to-back with another hard day.
both_rules.announcer: States the combined plan up front (e.g. 'Stage 4: Immovable Force. Fight — Grounded Power, 6 rounds. Then Fit — Grounding and Bracing, 6 workouts.').
